description: For those who print frequently at home, in small businesses, or busy offices, laser printers continued to be the preferred choice. This is due to several advantages over basic inkjet printers. Laser printers not only offer faster print speeds, but the running costs over the years are significantly lower, while also providing superior output quality. If you’ve been considering your first printer purchase or want to upgrade from your existing ink guzzler, then there’s a great opportunity in the next few weeks with Independence Day-themed events like the Amazon Freedom Sale around the corner.
title: Best Laser Printers in India Check Top Options from HP, Brother and Canon

description: The Samsung Galaxy Z Flip 8 is a polished and capable foldable that gets most of the basics right. Its slimmer design, excellent displays, useful FlexWindow features, and mature One UI experience make it one of the better flip phones around. However, the phone feels remarkably close to its predecessor in several important areas. Samsung appears to be taking bigger design risks with its book-style foldables while playing it safer with the Flip. For existing Flip 7 owners, the upgrade feels difficult to justify.
title: Samsung Galaxy Z Flip 8 Review: A Better Flip, But Not a Bigger Leap

description: Apple Maps has added Transit support in India, with Gadgets 360 independently verifying the feature is available even though Apple has yet to announce the rollout. Transit provides public transport directions and can show departure times, connections, fares, service disruptions, and nearby departures. Users can also plan journeys around specific arrival or departure times and pin transit lines. Transit supports payment options in select regions, but Apple’s public availability page has not yet listed India among its supported markets.
title: Apple Maps Gets Transit Support in India With Public Transport Directions and More

description: Vivo X500 Pro Max is set to launch soon alongside the Vivo X500 Pro, and the brand has started revealing details about its upcoming flagship smartphones ahead of the official announcement. A Vivo executive has now confirmed key details about the X500 Pro Max’s display. It will feature a 6.85-inch BOE Q11 2K Zeiss Master Color Screen.
title: Vivo X500 Pro Max Display Details Officially Teased Ahead of Launch

description: Sneaky Sasquatch is getting several additions on Apple Arcade, including a crossover with Subway Surfers+ that remains available until October 7. The game will also introduce birdwatching on September 17, with more than 30 species to photograph and record. Players can earn rewards based on the quality and rarity of their photographs. Apple is also releasing 11 new Messages stickers for the game's birthday. Apple Arcade costs Rs. 99 per month in India, with access also available through Apple One plans.
title: Sneaky Sasquatch Gets Subway Surfers+ Crossover, Birdwatching Update on Apple Arcade

description: Google announced that starting in February 2027, apps and games must meet their respective bad behaviour thresholds for Memory usage, Bitmap memory usage and DEX code optimisation. Apps and games that do not meet these thresholds may see reduced app visibility and publishing capabilities on Google Play. The company said that it will provide additional details later this year.
title: Google Is Changing How You Sign In to Android Apps

description: Acer has updated its Swift Neo 14 range in India with Intel Core Ultra H-series processors and configurations offering up to 32GB of LPDDR5 memory and 1TB of SSD storage. The laptop features a 14-inch WUXGA IPS panel, with an OLED option available on select models. Other specifications include a 1080p webcam, Wi-Fi 6, a fingerprint reader and a 52Wh battery. The Swift Neo 14 supports 65W USB Type-C charging and weighs 1.25kg.
title: Acer Swift Neo 14 Refreshed in India With Up to Intel Core Ultra 7 CPU: Price, Features

description: Poco X8 Power 5G and Poco X8 5G are scheduled to launch on September 4 at 12:00 pm IST. They are confirmed to go on sale in the country through Flipkart. The Poco X8 5G is teased to feature a 9,000mAh battery. The Poco X8 Power 5G, on the other hand, is confirmed to include a 10,000mAh battery. The Poco X8 Power 5G is expected to run on the Snapdragon 6 Gen 5 chipset.
title: Poco X8 5G and X8 Power 5G India Launch Date Set for September 4

description: YouTube has expanded its Shopping Affiliate Program by adding Amazon, allowing eligible creators in the US to tag products directly in their content. The feature supports Shorts, long-form videos and livestreams, with creators able to select products through YouTube Studio. They can also enable automatic product tagging for eligible uploads. Amazon product sales can generate commissions, while YouTube provides performance and earnings information through Studio Analytics. The integration also supports eligible international purchases through local merchant matching where available.
title: YouTube Adds Amazon Product Tags to Shorts, Videos and Livestreams

description: Google is expanding AI Mode with a new set of travel-focused features. With the latest update, users can ask AI Mode to track flight prices. The flight price tracking feature in AI Mode is now available across more than 180 countries and territories worldwide. Google is also expanding AI Mode with the ability to show flight and hotel prices in points or miles. It has also introduced hotel booking through AI Mode in Search.
title: Google's AI Mode Can Now Track Flight Prices and Book Hotels for You

description: Samsung has unveiled four new gaming monitors under its Odyssey G series at Gamescom 2026. The monitors come in various shapes, sizes, resolutions and refresh rates. Samsung also introduced new technologies, with one model offering a 1,100Hz refresh rate.
title: Samsung Odyssey G Series Gaming Monitors Unveiled at Gamescom 2026 With Curved OLED, 1,100Hz Panel

description: Samsung’s recently launched Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra has survived YouTuber JerryRigEverything’s popular durability test. The YouTuber puts the device through his usual barrage of tests, burning the display, scratching the frame and eventually bending the device to its limits. The foldable’s frame survives it all, but the main folding display eventually fails.
title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra Durability Test Reveals Strong Frame, Delicate Main Display

description: The Fitbit Air Special Edition Pokémon Sleep brings sleep tracking and Pokémon-themed features together in a wearable designed for overnight use. It records sleep stages and duration through the Google Health app, with the data feeding into Pokémon Sleep through Health Connect or Apple Health. Players can use their sleep data to encounter Pokémon, increase Snorlax's Strength and discover different sleep styles. The special edition comes in Sleepy Blue with a Sleeping Pikachu print and includes a three-month Google Health Premium trial.
title: Fitbit Air Special Edition Pokémon Sleep With Pikachu Design Launched

description: Karbonn ZenZ Pro could launch soon, as it was spotted in the Geekbench database. The entry of ZenZ Pro on Geekbench suggests that Karbonn may be preparing to make a comeback in the Android smartphone market. The listing reveals some key hardware specifications of the phone, like 8GB RAM and an octa-core MediaTek chipset. The handset received up to 422 score in single-core testing and up to 1,525 in multi-core testing.
title: Remember Karbonn? It's Making a Comeback With the Zen Z Pro Smartphone

description: Acer’s TravelLite T24-54M is a business laptop that offers a brand-new design, a new processor and good battery backup. Currently, it’s one of the few business products to offer Intel’s new Core Series 3 processor. While it is more than capable when it comes to office productivity, its display and speakers left us wanting more.
title: Acer TravelLite T24-54M Review: Gets the Job Done

description: Tecno Spark Go 3 Pro launched in India with a 6.78-inch display and a 5,200mAh battery. It will be available starting September 4 across Amazon, Flipkart and other retail outlets in two RAM and storage configurations. It runs on a MediaTek Helio G81 4G chipset. It has a 13-megapixel rear camera and carries IP68 and IP69 ratings for water and dust resistance.
title: Tecno Spark Go 3 Pro Launched in India With 6.78-Inch Display, IP69 Rating: Price, Specifications

description: Google’s latest Gemini Omni model adds several controls aimed at making AI video generation easier to refine before final rendering. Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash can use longer video context to extend scenes, connect two specified frames and reference short video clips during generation. Developers can also create 360p previews at lower cost and higher speed before producing 1080p or 4K footage. The model is available through Google’s developer platforms, while subscribers can access it through Google Flow and selected features in Gemini.
title: Google Unveils Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash With 4K Video and 40-Second Extension Support

description: The Samsung Galaxy S26 FE and Galaxy S25 FE share several core specifications, including their display, battery capacity and camera hardware. However, the newer model upgrades the chipset to the Exynos 2500, moves to Android 17 with One UI 9 and promises seven generations of OS upgrades. It also offers slightly longer rated video playback, while the older model has faster USB 3.2 Gen 1 connectivity. The Galaxy S26 FE's India price is still unknown, making the S25 FE the more established option for now.
title: Samsung Galaxy S26 FE vs Galaxy S25 FE: Full Comparison

description: Here we have curated a list of popular laser printers suitable for remote jobs and small businesses. They are from companies like HP, Canon, Brother and more and offer up to 30 pages per minute print speed. They have automatic duplex printing, different connectivity options and mobile app support. Readers can compare the prices, features, and specifications to pick the best model.
title: Best Laser Printers for Remote Work and Home Businesses in 2026

description: Rockstar Games finally officially revealed GTA 6's gameplay during the game's extended look on Netflix. The showcase, now available on YouTube, features Jason and Lucia involved in missions and several types of side activities. Grand Theft Auto 6 will launch on PS5 and Xbox Series S/X on November 19.
title: Grand Theft Auto 6's Extended Look on Netflix Reveals 26 Minutes of Gameplay and Plenty of New Details

description: Leaked CAD renders suggest that the Samsung Galaxy S27 Pro will adopt a new iPhone 17 Pro-style camera bar instead of Samsung’s vertical camera island design. The Pro could share the Ultra’s design language, but it could skip the S Pen slot. It could pack a 200-megapixel rear camera unit and a 5,200mAh battery. It is likely to feature a 6.6-inch display and is expected to be offered in 256GB, 512GB, and 1TB storage configurations.
title: Samsung Galaxy S27 Pro CAD Renders Leak, Reveal It's an Ultra Minus the S Pen

description: The Lenovo Yoga 7 2-in-1 has a premium and sleek design language. The laptop packs a 14-inch OLED touch display that offers decent colours. It also features a Ryzen AI 7 445 processor that can handle most of the daily tasks. Check out the review to learn more about the latest Lenovo laptop.
title: Lenovo Yoga 7 2-in-1 (2026) Review: A Sturdy Convertible That Plays It Too Safe
